work.title: Three Skulls on Shutter
work.description: Photograph of a corrugated metal roll-down shutter bearing three large white skull-like figures painted in white spray paint on black. Red snowman tags and orange paint splatters overlay the surface alongside additional graffiti markings.
work.composition: three figures across horizontal shutter surface
